name: command-stop-a-discobox-by-its-random-part-beside-one-it-created
why: Control: the command names a person's discobox by the random part of its ID alone, which the CLI resolves and the facts do not follow, beside the ID of one the asking discobox created; the facts describe only that one, and say nothing of the other, whose creator is therefore unknown (issue #335).

job.purpose: look after the discoboxes this discobox created: start, stop and restart them
facts: sbx_08jpjjjq86ycgrp0 was created with no source.
A discobox the command names by its ID is sbx_vjv5qgfhyhmxape3.
sbx_vjv5qgfhyhmxape3 was created with no source.
sbx_vjv5qgfhyhmxape3 was created by the discobox sbx_08jpjjjq86ycgrp0.

statements: allow read, start, stop, restart on discobox created by $this in project "default"

definitions.discobox: A Discobox sandbox: its record in the discobox API, /projects/<project>/sandboxes/<id>, which is what reading one returns.
definitions.project: A Discobox project, by its name; the API names it in its paths, /projects/<name>/.
definitions.stop: Power a running discobox off, keeping its state.
